PLAN "Postpartum Return to Movement — 12-Week Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild core, pelvic floor, and whole-body strength safely after C-section"

PHASES

  PHASE "Phase 1 — Gentle Reactivation" (2 weeks):

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Breath and Body Awareness":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x6 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 3m

      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Gentle Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_circles 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          cat_cow 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 3m

      DAY Friday training 20m "Walk and Restore":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 3m

    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Breath and Body Awareness":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 3m

      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Gentle Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_circles 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 3m

      DAY Friday training 25m "Walk and Restore":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 3m

  PHASE "Phase 2 — Six-Week Check Cleared: Foundation Building" (4 weeks):

    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Lower Body and Glutes":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m

      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper Body and Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          prone_T 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          prone_Y 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          push_up 3x6 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m

      DAY Friday training 30m "Full Body Gentle":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x6 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds

    WEEK 4:
